This '''Inn''' was located in [[Cuipernam]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] it was the site of a [[First skirmish in Cuipernam|skirmish]] between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] hired by [[Ogomoor]], [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] to [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg the Hutt]]. It was later destroyed in a second skirmish that took place in Cuipernam.
